d4.name: cellAddr
d4.why: the cell being written, advanced by the routine itself with `addq.l #$1,d4` - so it is a running address and not a fixed one.

d2.name: cellValue
d2.why: masked to 0x3f before the owner bits are or-ed in, so only its low six bits - the kind - survive into the board.

d5.name: ownerBits
d5.why: or-ed into the top of the cell byte after the mask, which is the 0xc0 owner field the enclosure test, the flood fill and the piece walker all read.

d6.name: endMark
d6.why: the walk stops when the RAW cell byte at the address in d4 equals it (0x6576) - the whole byte, not the low six bits the dispatch at 0x635a masks off. Every entry of the family carries it.
